title: Lecturer on Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Sungyong Ban, DDS, MMSc, is a lecturer in prosthodontics. He earned his Doctor of Dental Surgery (DDS) from the UCLA School of Dentistry and completed his specialty training in prosthodontics at Harvard School of Dental Medicine, where he also received a Master of Medical Sciences (MMSC) degree. His research focuses on digital dentistry and its applications in removable prosthodontics. Ban serves as a part-time faculty member in the Department of Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences.
